summary: Pitch Grand Designs and Your Home Made Perfect first as they rank highest for the brand among likely candidates. Ads should target DIY genre viewers on HGTV, BBC Two, Channel 4, and BBC One to reach ages under 25, 30 to 34, 35 to 44, leans female.

placements.why: This documentary about ambitious home builds attracts viewers who care deeply about design and quality living spaces, matching your brand's focus on thoughtful home essentials.
placements.send: Parachute bedding set, one queen size
placements.pitch:
Dear set decoration team,

Parachute offers premium bedding that would fit naturally in Grand Designs scenes showcasing completed bedroom renovations or quiet moments in newly built master suites. Our soft linen duvet could rest on a bed during a final reveal or be folded neatly in a closet tour. The product is free with no paid placement required and we can ship within a week. We believe your audience appreciates quality home essentials that complement architectural vision. Please let us know if this works for an upcoming episode. Best regards, Parachute

platforms.name: Universal Ads (Comcast)
platforms.how: Self serve from as little as $100, with no minimum commitment. Target viewers of content genres, plus age, gender and location. Reaches NBCUniversal, Fox, Paramount and others.

platforms.name: Amazon Sponsored TV
platforms.how: Self serve with no minimum spend, for brands that sell on Amazon in the US. Runs on Prime Video, Twitch and Fire TV apps. Target by genre and audience.

ads.note: Self serve platforms sell genres and audiences, not single shows. These shows are why these genres were chosen.
setup: Open Universal Ads and start a new campaign. It is self serve, from as little as $100.
